mathematical_contract.axis_relation: For a selected root x of f(x)=sum_j f_j*x^j with nonzero leading f_d, every high tensor power is replaced exactly by x^d=-sum_{j<d}(f_j/f_d)*x^j. An exact rational parameter uses the equivalent relation x-authored_value=0.
mathematical_contract.multivariate_remainder: Each axis is reduced independently in descending power order. Because the defining relations use disjoint variables, sequential reductions commute and the final tensor has exactly the source value at the selected root tuple.
mathematical_contract.storage: The bounded nested tensor is rectangularized once per reduced axis. High first-axis planes and second-axis rows are moved with mem::take; third-axis coefficients are moved with mem::replace. No table of quotient powers or per-fiber polynomial remainders is retained.
mathematical_contract.post_reduction_authority: At the existing eight-refinement symbolic cut, a changed tensor first receives a STRICT structural-zero check and a STRICT Bernstein sign on the selected box, then the existing affine-relation and selected-root linear-resultant authorities. These are proofs about the reduced value at the selected tuple, never about equality away from the roots.
mathematical_contract.resource_bound: Checked dimension products preserve the existing 16384-control ceiling; reduction can only shrink an axis and returns no authority when exact scalar division cannot be formed.
mathematical_contract.policy: Supportable quotient-reduced zeros are Certified under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption. A reduced tensor that remains genuinely nonlinear in all three cubic fields stays Predicate uncertainty in STRICT; only APPROXIMATE_512 may return On after recording the shared 512-bit terminal.
mathematical_contract.failure: No floating tolerance, approximate quotient, guessed conjugate, compatibility shim, or second Boolean engine is introduced.

capability.comparison_revision: The deliberately factored non-affine control was quadratic in all three stored axes, so the sole-linear-axis authority could not run; STRICT was uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 consumed its terminal.
capability.source_revision: Quadratic selected-root relations reduce the same tensor from 3x3x3 to 2x2x3, exposing a linear axis for exact selected-root resultant replay under both policies.
capability.reduced_fixture: The non-affine chord a*b-c*(a+b), multiplied by (1+a)*(1+b)*(1+c), now returns Certified Zero under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption.
capability.differential_axis_coverage: A dense 4x3x5 tensor reduced modulo x^2-x on each possible axis preserves exact evaluation at x=1 and produces the expected degree bound.
capability.remaining_policy_control: For positive cubic roots a^3=1/2, b^3=1/3, c^3=1/6, the zero (a*b-c)*(1+a)*(1+b)*(1+c) remains quadratic in each degree-three field. STRICT remains explicitly uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 consumes the terminal.
capability.remaining_exactness_boundary: Extract or prove a selected zero factor from quotient-reduced tensors that remain nonlinear in every field, then reserve a bounded compositum authority for irreducible cases.
